gold_comments.issue_summary:
```suggestion
    path = unquote(urlparse(public_url).path)  # extract path from a 'file:///' URI
```
gold_comments.evidence_requirement: The added line `path = url.netloc if url.netloc else url.path` fails to decode URL-encoded paths, risking incorrect file access when the path contains percent-encoded characters.
gold_comments.rationale: A public URL may contain percent-encoded characters in its path; using the raw path without decoding can cause file-system lookups to fail or access wrong files.
